ROOT_CAUSE: Credit was awarded by string equality between two different derivations of the same idea. The grid row's occurrence key is the first and last date of its visible strip; the detail page prints its own dates. The exact match failed, and the one fallback was guarded by 'not occurrence' -- false in exactly the case the fallback exists for -- so no credit ever landed, calendar_scan_pending stayed true, and the brain re-opened the same entry for ever. The fix reads the evidence the detail actually carries: the dates in its occurrence key (both the '10/04' and the '9月26日' shapes) are matched against the row's own calendar_dates_raw. Two fitting rows is a coin flip and credits nothing; a key with no parseable date still credits nothing; the no-key-at-all path is unchanged.
